ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white) across the central 75% of the fluke surface; low-intensity (black) pixels define the 25% perimeter and localized interior clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central regions are contiguous high-intensity zones. Discrete low-intensity (black) circular blobs are distributed across the high-intensity field: six on the left lobe, three on the right lobe. High-contrast mottling is concentrated at the fluke base and along the trailing edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 50 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Left lobe trailing edge shows extreme macro-scale irregularity including a deep traumatic indentation. Right lobe trailing edge exhibits moderate-frequency serrations with pixel-amplitude variations of approximately 5-10 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Outer edges follow a concave curve from the notch toward the distal tips; left tip shows a more irregular, truncated trajectory due to structural loss.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular dark pixel clusters (5-15 pixel diameters) detected on the high-intensity ventral surface, notably 6 in the left mid-lobe and 3 in the right mid-lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A single distinct dark linear mark on the right lobe oriented diagonally; multiple faint, horizontal linear disruptions visible on the upper left lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant tissue loss (major notch) on the superior margin of the left lobe. Extensive white-on-black dendritic scarring patterns on the distal extremity of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique filigree-like white pigmentation pattern localized within the low-intensity black zone of the left fluke tip.
